_comment: Known sub-44px controls in the first phone screen of each public route, as
measured on 2026-09-11 in Mobile Chrome (Pixel 5) and Mobile Safari
(iPhone 12). The smoke spec fails on anything NOT listed here, so this file
can only shrink.
It exists because the gate was red the moment it was switched on, and a
gate that blocks every PR on pre-existing debt gets disabled within a day.
Same reasoning, and the same shape, as scripts/ts-error-baseline.json and
the vitest ratchet: require NO REGRESSION rather than require green.
To retire an entry: make the control >= 44x44, then delete its line. Do not
add entries to make a failing run pass unless the new control is genuinely
pre-existing debt you are deliberately deferring - that is what turns a
ratchet back into decoration.
Keyed on route + class + label, NOT on size, so that a control shrinking
further still passes while one that appears anew does not. Size is recorded
alongside for the reader only.
THE EN/ES ENTRIES WERE PHANTOM AND HAVE BEEN REMOVED. They were recorded
by a lane run pointed at the SHARED F: CHECKOUT, whose af-landing.css was
dirty with a peer's unlanded rework converting .af-lp-nav-right from
display:none to display:contents on phones. Under that tree the language
pills render 36x44 and got baselined. Under origin/main they are
clientRects=0 at 390px, so the spec's visibility check skips them and they
are never reported -- which would have made these two entries STALE and
turned the lane red on a clean CI checkout.
The lesson is not about this control: A LANE IS ONLY AS TRUSTWORTHY AS THE
TREE ITS SERVER IS SERVING. A dev server started in the shared checkout
serves whatever every other session has uncommitted. Baseline against a
clean checkout of the commit, or read the blob you are actually measuring.
WHEN THAT PEER REWORK LANDS the pills become visible at 36x44 and the lane
will report them as a REGRESSION, because nothing baselines them. That is
correct: a control that becomes reachable on a phone at 36px wide is a new
phone defect, and it should be sized when it is surfaced, not pre-excused.
